Package com.lemarketjames.surveillance

Class OrderAlert

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.surveillance.OrderAlert
@Entity public class OrderAlert extends Object
One order brought to Trading Operations' attention. An alert raised when the order was placed has what was ordered; one raised from a later status change has the order, its account and why. Written once from the event and never changed, so it has no setters. The table's created_at column is filled by the database and is not mapped.

An order has at most one alert per reason. The key is declared here as well as in database/schema/019, so the tests' generated schema refuses a second one exactly as PostgreSQL does.

    • OrderAlert

      public OrderAlert(OrderStatusChangedMessage rejection, AlertReason reason)
      An alert about an order that was rejected, so it happened when the order changed status. The status change says nothing of what was ordered, and nothing orders its topic against the placement's (contract C6), so those fields stay empty; staff read them in the order's timeline.
      Parameters:
      rejection - the order's move to REJECTED, with its reason
      reason - why the alert is raised
